title: Members
readOnly: You can view members. Managing membership requires the members.manage permission.

dialog.addBody: Enter the email of an existing account on this instance. To invite someone new, ask an instance admin for an invitation link.
dialog.editBody: Choose the permissions this member should have in this project.
dialog.removeBody: This removes their project membership. Their instance account and membership in other projects remain. Instance admins can still access every project.
dialog.selfEdit: Changing your own role may remove your ability to manage this project.
dialog.selfRemove: You are removing your own membership. You may lose access to this project.
